arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK029. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Right-facing upright head/upper-body at a thin white waterline. One wide white eye with black pupil, rounded head, pointed snout right, broad open smiling mouth with distinct small pink tongue resting at lower-right inside. Pale cheek/jaw is tall. Follow this mouth phase precisely; no full body or tail. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
